description: Non-degenerate shifted oscillatory angle-structured quadrature-QAE microcampaign. The base term is shifted from 0.50 to 0.55 to preserve the smooth oscillatory profile and the G_4^(3) angle class while breaking the a=1/2 MLAE degeneracy observed for oscillatory_smooth.

selected_jobs.purpose: Degree-3 angle-structured quadrature instance with non-degenerate MLAE probabilities for K={0,1,2}.

stopping_rules: Run first without --submit and inspect the actual depth and two-qubit count.
Submit K={0,1,2} only if k=2 remains within a controlled or explicitly justified borderline regime.
If k=2 is still too deep, submit a K={0,1} reduced control only after creating a separate campaign file.
Use this case to test the angle-class argument; do not mix it with the degenerate base=0.50 oscillatory_smooth result.
